description: Enter two sets and compute their union, intersection, differences and symmetric difference instantly, with subset and equality checks.

faqs.q: How do I enter a set?
faqs.a: Type elements separated by commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines — for example: apple, banana, cherry. Duplicates are removed automatically.
The symmetric difference A △ B contains elements that are in exactly one of the two sets — everything in the union except the intersection.
Yes. 'Apple' and 'apple' are treated as different elements, because sets distinguish values exactly as typed.

howto: Type the elements of set A, separated by commas or new lines.
Type the elements of set B the same way.
All six operations — union, intersection, both differences, symmetric difference and cardinality — update instantly.
Check whether one set is a subset of the other or whether the sets are equal.
